propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 collapses failed criteria to empty success and omits policy/prompt/contract/topology from checkpoint identity, losing operational context and trustworthiness of partial results.

Plan-review must adapt Round-A discovery topology into DiscoveryStagePlan units, execute through the S2 shared kernel, and persist versioned traces and digest-complete envelopes in a reducer-ignored review journal to preserve operational lessons while obtaining trustworthy partial results.

Failed local units must not serialize as clean checkpoints; earlier successes survive, independent work continues, dependents skip, and the final verdict follows the approved failure policy (preserve findings, return INDETERMINATE for missing blocking-capable coverage unless a real blocking finding wins BLOCK, allow advisory-only gaps to pass).

The new checkpoint key must change when any material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace input changes; corrupt and legacy entries produce zero reuse while only content-identical success/resume envelopes seed reuse.

Plan-review must preserve existing YAML/BPMN graph, facet packing, one-criterion fallback, model ladder, centrality-derived default cap, bounded concurrency, cache warming, container/prerequisite calls, and live cancellation checks with no new operator configuration flag or duplicate LLM calls introduced.
